description:
Per-process / per-session usage telemetry: tool-call counts, the last-N calls, and process uptime.

**Best for:** "what have I called this session?" / debugging an agent loop / seeing which tools dominate usage.
**Returns:** session_started, uptime, total_calls, per-tool counts (high→low), most-recent calls (newest first, capped by recent_limit).
**Scope:** in-memory, per-process — resets on restart. Nothing persists or leaves the process. Auth-free.

format.description: Output format. 'markdown' (default): human-readable report. 'json': structured object for programmatic agent use.

recent_limit.description: How many of the most-recent tool calls to include in the recent_calls list. Default 10, max 100. Counts and totals always cover the whole session regardless of this value.

name: novada_session_stats
title: Session Stats
